title: Learning Assessment Dashboard
subtitle: CRLA · RMA · Philippine Early Childhood Development Checklist — Regional Summary

catalog.name: Comprehensive Rapid Literacy Assessment (CRLA)
catalog.description: The CRLA identifies learners' literacy levels to guide reading instruction and targeted intervention. Learners are classified into Full Refresher, Moderate Refresher, Light Refresher, and Grade Ready.
catalog.interpretation: Region XII shows 35.1% of learners classified as Grade Ready, while 28.4% require full reading refresher. The distribution indicates meaningful progress but underscores the need for continued literacy interventions, particularly in Cotabato Province and Tacurong City.

catalog.name: Reading Management Assessment (RMA)
catalog.description: The RMA monitors reading progress of learners in higher grade levels, guiding teachers in adjusting reading instruction and managing reading programs.
catalog.interpretation: Combined proficient and advanced readers reach 45.7% regionally. Gen. Santos and South Cotabato lead in reading proficiency, while Tacurong City needs intensified reading recovery programs. The RMA confirms steady improvement in sustained silent reading and comprehension.

catalog.name: Philippine Early Childhood Development Checklist
catalog.description: The Philippine ECD Checklist assesses the developmental status of early learners across gross motor, fine motor, self-help, receptive language, expressive language, cognitive, and socio-emotional domains.
catalog.interpretation: The vast majority (87.4%) of early learners are developmentally on track. South Cotabato leads with 90.2% on-track children. Slight variations across divisions point to targeted early childhood stimulation needs in Tacurong and Kidapawan.
